name: visual-prompt-architect
description: Designs production-ready prompts for posters and infographics from requirements, parameters, and reference images.

interface.longDescription: Transforms user requirements, design parameters, and up to 12 reference images into structured, production-ready poster and infographic prompts using a multi-layer design workflow and quality review.
defaultPrompt: Create a professional poster prompt from my requirements and reference images.
Design an infographic prompt using A4 portrait unless I specify otherwise.
Review my poster requirements and build the strongest visual direction before writing the final prompt.
